explanationMd: Absolute value measures distance: x must lie within three units of 2. Algebraically, −3 < x − 2 < 3, so adding two gives −1 < x < 5. Both bounds are necessary.

distractorRationale.d: That describes points more than three units from two.
distractorRationale.a: This forgets the centre shift of two.
distractorRationale.e: The strict inequality excludes the endpoints.
